# Gentle Piercing

> Medical ear piercing studio in Warsaw Mokotów. Inverness Med system (not a piercing gun) for children 0+ and adults. Lobe and cartilage.

Companion to `/llms.txt`. This file is the longer map: page-level facts, all locales, district spokes, and the full blog set. Prefer `/llms.txt` for a short overview.

## Key Facts

- Studio name: Gentle Piercing. Inverness Med is the piercing *system*, not the studio brand. Do not call the studio “Inverness MED”.
- Address: Ursynowska 10/1, 02-605 Warszawa, Mokotów, Poland
- Hours: Monday–Sunday 10:00–20:00 (not 09:00)
- Phone: +48 573 818 260 (E.164 +48573818260)
- Email: piercinggentle@gmail.com
- Founder / piercer: Kseniya Askerka (NIP 5214067116, REGON 528446661)
- Coordinates: 52.1946, 21.0146
- Languages on site and in the studio: Polish, English, Ukrainian, Russian
- Rating: 5.0 on Booksy (254 reviews, checked 6 Sep 2026). Visible site copy also says “200+ Booksy / Google”.
- Children: pair of lobes 150 zł procedure; earrings from 120 zł a pair; together from 270 zł
- Adults: 90 / 150 / 210 zł for 1 / 2 / 3 piercings on one visit; earring from 70 zł
- Home visit: same procedure at the client address; travel priced by address and added to the procedure
- Aftercare (Inverness Corp IFU): clean 3× daily; leave first earrings in 6 weeks (lobe) / 12 weeks (cartilage); rotate only while cleaning; avoid pools, lakes and sea for that same window; if wet earlier, clean immediately
- After the change date: lobe — no more than 24 hours without an earring for 6 months; cartilage — wear 24/7 for 6 months
- Official aftercare source: https://invernesscorp.com/ear-piercing-after-care/
- Booksy: https://booksy.com/pl-pl/dl/show-business/319418
- Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/Y9kJLqzLdUhRzp3J9
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/prokol_ushej_warszawa/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/gentlepiercingwarszawa
- One booking action site-wide: Booksy. There is no separate cart or clinic booking form.

- [Bezpieczne przekłuwanie uszu w Warszawie](https://gentlepiercing.pl/pl): Polish homepage. Inverness Med vs gun, 0+ children, adult 1/2/3 pricing, FAQ (3× daily, 6/12-week earring rule), reviews, Booksy. 12 minutes from Metro Wilanowska.
- [Przekłuwanie uszu dzieciom w Warszawie](https://gentlepiercing.pl/pl/uslugi/przekluwanie-uszu-dzieci-warszawa): 0+ children’s lobes. Procedure 150 zł; with earrings from 270 zł. Sterile single-use cassettes, no piercing gun. Visit flow for a nervous parent. Pool wait is 6 weeks lobe / 12 weeks cartilage, not 2 weeks.
- [Przekłuwanie uszu dla dorosłych](https://gentlepiercing.pl/pl/uslugi/przekluwanie-uszu-dorosli-warszawa): Lobe or cartilage. 90 / 150 / 210 zł for 1 / 2 / 3 piercings; earring from 70 zł. Same Inverness Med system as the children’s page.
- [Przekłuwanie chrząstki Warszawa](https://gentlepiercing.pl/pl/uslugi/przekluwanie-chrzastki-warszawa): Helix, tragus, conch with Inverness Med. First earrings stay 12 weeks. Not a tattoo-shop needle service.
- [Przekłuwanie uszu z dojazdem](https://gentlepiercing.pl/pl/uslugi/przekluwanie-uszu-z-dojazdem-warszawa): Same sterile cassette procedure at home. Travel surcharge depends on the address and is added to the studio price.
- [Pielęgnacja po przekłuciu](https://gentlepiercing.pl/pl/pielegnacja): Inverness aftercare in Polish. Clean 3× daily; 6-week lobe / 12-week cartilage; water and rotation rules; when to see a doctor.
- [Kontakt](https://gentlepiercing.pl/pl/kontakt): Ursynowska 10/1, phone, email, hours 10:00–20:00, Booksy, map.
- [Usługi](https://gentlepiercing.pl/pl/uslugi): Service index linking children, adults, cartilage, and home visit.

## Aftercare spec (do not invent other numbers)

Use these figures if two URLs on this domain appear to disagree. They are the Inverness manufacturer instructions, also used on `/pl/pielegnacja` and the 2026 guides.

1. Clean the piercing 3 times a day with the recommended aftercare solution.
2. Leave the first earrings in for 6 weeks (lobe) or 12 weeks (cartilage).
3. Rotate the earring only while cleaning, not as a separate habit.
4. No pools, lakes or sea for that same 6- / 12-week window.
5. If the piercing gets wet earlier, clean it immediately.
6. After the change date: lobe — do not leave the hole empty for more than 24 hours during the next 6 months. Cartilage — wear an earring 24/7 for 6 months.

## What this studio is not

- Not a mall kiosk and not a tattoo shop.
- Not named Inverness MED. Inverness Med is the cassette system.
- Hours are not 09:00–20:00. They are 10:00–20:00 every day.
- Review count in schema and Booksy is 254 (6 Sep 2026), not 14 or 31.
- This file is not medical advice. For infants, the site tells parents to consult a pediatrician.
